title: Page heading of the Settings console (/settings). Noun, 1 word.
navLabel: aria-label of the Settings sub-navigation rail. Screen-reader only, names the region.
appearance.title: Panel heading above the theme picker. Noun, 1 word.
appearance.themeLabel: aria-label of the theme radiogroup. Screen-reader only, 1 word.
appearance.theme.system: Theme option: follow the operating system. Fits a narrow radio tile, ≤1 word.
appearance.theme.light: Theme option: always the light theme. Fits a narrow radio tile, ≤1 word.
appearance.theme.dark: Theme option: always the dark theme. Fits a narrow radio tile, ≤1 word.
appearance.systemHintDark: Hint under the theme picker when 'System' is selected AND the OS currently resolves to dark. One full sentence. Do not interpolate the theme name — write the sentence out, so adjectives can agree.
appearance.systemHintLight: Same as appearance.systemHintDark, but the OS currently resolves to light.
appearance.fixedHintDark: Hint under the theme picker when the user pinned the dark theme, overriding the OS. Mentions that it applies to this device only. One full sentence.
appearance.fixedHintLight: Same as appearance.fixedHintDark, but the light theme is pinned.
language.title: Panel heading above the language picker. Noun, 1 word.
language.groupLabel: aria-label of the language radiogroup. Screen-reader only, ≤2 words.
language.hint: Hint under the language picker. Two short sentences: the choice is stored ON THE ACCOUNT so every device the operator signs in on follows it (it used to be device-only, before users.locale existed), and data the user enters is never translated. This is a promise about scope, so be precise, not chatty.
password.title: Panel heading of the change-password form. Noun phrase.
password.current: Field label: the password the user has right now.
password.new: Field label: the password they want instead.
password.confirm: Field label: retype the new password.
password.hint: Hint under the new-password field stating the minimum length (8 characters). One short sentence.
password.submit: Submit button of the change-password form. Imperative, ≤3 words.
password.success: Confirmation shown next to the button after a successful change. ≤3 words, past tense. A ✓ glyph is rendered separately in markup — do not include it.
password.errors.currentRequired: Field error: the current-password field was left empty. Says what to do.
password.errors.tooShort: Field error: the new password is under 8 characters. Says what to do.
password.errors.mismatch: Field error: the two new-password fields differ.
password.errors.failed: Banner error when the API rejects the change for an unknown reason. No trailing period (it sits alone in an error box).
account.title: Panel heading above the user's own email address, read-only. Noun, 1 word.
version.title: Panel heading of the About / version card on Settings → General (right column on large screens). Noun, 1 word.
version.checking: Transient status while the version endpoint is loading. One short phrase, may end with an ellipsis character …
version.running: Label for the version string this instance is running. Noun phrase, ≤2 words.
version.latest: Label for the newest GitHub Release version. Noun phrase, ≤2 words.
version.upToDate: Hint when running version equals or is newer than the latest release. One short sentence. Do not interpolate version numbers.
version.updateAvailable: Banner when a newer GitHub Release exists. One short sentence. Do not interpolate version numbers — they are shown separately.
version.checkFailed: Hint when GitHub could not be reached. Still shows the running version. One short sentence.
version.devHint: Hint when APP_VERSION is the local-dev sentinel `dev`. Explains this is a development build, not a release image. One short sentence.
version.releaseLink: External link to the GitHub Release page when an update is available. Imperative or noun phrase, ≤3 words.
controlPlane.title: Panel heading of the Control Plane card on Settings → General. Product name — stays Control Plane in both languages.
controlPlane.loading: Transient status while GET /api/system/control-plane/status loads. May end with …
controlPlane.telemetry: Label for whether outbound telemetry heartbeats are enabled. Noun, 1 word. Glossary: telemetry → telemetria.
controlPlane.telemetryOn: Value when telemetry is enabled. Short. PL: feminine agreeing with telemetria.
controlPlane.telemetryOff: Value when TELEMETRY_DISABLED (or equivalent) is set. Short. PL: feminine agreeing with telemetria.
controlPlane.installationId: Label for the UUID identifying this install. ≤2 words.
controlPlane.registeredEmail: Label for the email registered with Control Plane. ≤2 words.
controlPlane.notRegistered: Value when registeredEmail is null. Short adjective/phrase. PL: feminine agreeing with instancja.
controlPlane.lastHeartbeat: Label for the ISO timestamp of the last successful heartbeat. ≤2 words. Glossary: heartbeat stays English.
controlPlane.never: Value when lastHeartbeatAt is null. One short word.
controlPlane.notConfigured: Hint when CONTROL_PLANE_URL is missing. Mentions the env var name. One short sentence.
controlPlane.emailLabel: Label of the register form email field. ≤2 words.
controlPlane.register: Submit button posting the admin email to Control Plane. Imperative, 1 word.
controlPlane.registering: Same button while the request is in flight. Ends with …
controlPlane.registered: Success toast after register. Past tense, ≤3 words.
controlPlane.copyId: title/aria of the button that copies installationId. Imperative, ≤3 words.
controlPlane.copied: Toast after clipboard write succeeds. Past tense, 1 word.
controlPlane.copyFailed: Toast when clipboard write fails. What happened + what to do. One short sentence.
controlPlane.loadFailed: Fallback when the status request fails. One short sentence.
controlPlane.errors.emailRequired: Field error: email left empty. Says what to do.
controlPlane.errors.registerFailed: Banner when register POST fails. What happened + what to check. No apology.
